sections.h: Rule out psychotic disorder due to substances / medical condition

flows.title: Psychotic Disorders

nodes.t: Psychosis — Rule out psychotic disorder due to substances and/or general medical condition
Prominent mood syndrome (major depression, mania) present for significant portion of illness
Mood syndromes absent (or brief relative to duration of psychotic symptoms)

nodes.d: Psychotic symptoms present exclusively during major mood syndrome
Psychotic symptoms also present outside of mood episodes

nodes.t: Psychotic symptoms not limited to delusions
Psychotic symptoms limited to non-bizarre delusions only

nodes.d:
Duration of illness ≤ 1 month

1 or more:

  1. Delusions
  2. Hallucinations
  3. Disorganized speech
  4. Grossly disorganized or catatonic behaviour

Duration of illness 1-6 months

2 or more (1 must be 1-3):

  1. Delusions
  2. Hallucinations
  3. Disorganized speech
  4. Grossly disorganized or catatonic behaviour
  5. Negative sx (affective flattening, alogia, avolition)

Duration of illness ≥ 6 months

Criteria: see schizophreniform disorder

Suicide = 10%

Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome: Side effects of anti-psychotics. Sx: Hyperpyrexia (>38.5°C), muscle rigidity and mental status changes. 20% mortality
Non-bizarre delusions ≥ 1 month, no decline in functioning, behaviour is not odd
Delusions developed in context of close relationship with a person with already established similar delusion

edges.l: Psychotic sx only during mood syndrome
Psychotic sx also outside mood episodes
